description: Kissfessionals is where confessions are meant to be heard—not hidden. Hosted by Crystal A-Ego and Sarah Sauce, the podcast turns real confessions into real conversations that go beneath the surface and straight to the truth. Each episode explores the thoughts we whisper, the desires we bury, and the questions we talk ourselves out of asking. But the conversation doesn’t stop at the confession. We compare listener experiences to polls, data, and research to reveal just how common—and human—these feelings really are.
